subsystem: address-based result classification and numeric workspace effects
implementation: Handwritten readable C; original instructions execute only in independent tests

implemented_routines.name: fx_result_classify_address
implemented_routines.scope: Raw header admission, zero/negative/positive classes, wrapping sign-byte addition and opposite-sign compact-surd decimal conversion; complete persistent numeric workspace and typed continuation

implemented_routines.name: compact component expansion
implemented_routines.scope: Six canonical BCD component records, first-zero coefficient shortcut, three-digit radicands and raw positive-zero constructors

implemented_routines.name: component decimal evaluation
implemented_routines.scope: Fixed component workspace0: sqrt/coefficient/denominator order, first-zero skip, guard fields, aligned smaller operand and final plain addition/storage

implemented_routines.name: operand field loading
implemented_routines.scope: Saved argument before external record snapshot, reversed finite workspace order and native even-tail advancement for odd source aliases

api: fx_result_classify_address(platform, source, companion, result) returns a numerical status; result retains class and semantic continuation needed by consecutive header calls. No CPU state or CPU locals are stored by C.
prepared_domain: Opposite-sign compact surds have canonical BCD coefficients0..99, radicands0..999, denominators0..99 and sign pair1/6; numeric-workspace source aliases and address wrap are excluded for conversion.
Direct classification branches admit arbitrary byte records and overlapping operand/argument bus sources.
Sources intersecting native CPU stack8D00..8DED are rejected before writes. Unsupported conversion inputs retain only native argument/load prefix effects.
Final RAM/MMIO parity includes8000..805F and8640..867B. Intermediate arithmetic store counts and instruction ordering are not a mathematical API contract.
gaps: Malformed compact-surds and CPU-stack aliases are explicit prepared-domain exclusions.
General arbitrary-address finite arithmetic scratch APIs and physical CPU/peripheral timing remain outside this adapter.
